exposure: Department policy on cesarean delivery on maternal request
department policy on cesarean delivery on maternal request
outcome: Maternity department policies regarding cesarean delivery on maternal request
Obstetricians' support for cesarean delivery on maternal request in specific cases
cohort: 22 maternity department directors and 222 obstetricians from the majority of Israeli hospitals
finding: Policies and obstetricians' support for cesarean delivery on maternal request in Israel vary broadly depending on clinical profiles and physician characteristics, with department policy significantly impacting obstetricians' support.
mod_finding: This study investigated obstetricians' support for cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) and found that while most did not support CDMR in low-risk pregnancies, support varied depending on patient characteristics and hospital policy.
